verdict.rationale: The axis applies: a hosted scraping platform could plausibly offer an open-source, self-hostable edition. However, nothing in the pack documents that Apify or any of its scrapers can be self-hosted, or that any component is open source. Crawlee is named only as "our own web crawling and browser automation library" with no open-source or self-hosting claim, and the freely usable Docker base images are developer building blocks, so neither earns credit.

support.subject: As a developer, I can self-host an open-source version of the scraper instead of relying on a hosted cloud service
